name: Runner Extras - Environment Type Default
brief: Issue #3514: the runner's tenant is not a sandbox unless a test says so, and the test-toolkit environment setters are honored.
description: Runner-configuration claim, not a BC-behaviour claim. What IsSandbox/IsSaaS answer by default is a property of how a service tier is CONFIGURED (CustomSettings TenantEnvironmentType), and the al-language corpus tier deliberately configures Sandbox, so the corpus cannot pin the runner's default. The runner used to call NavTenantSettingsHelper.SetTestTenantEnvironmentType(true) on the first test of every run; no Business Central service-tier assembly calls that method (only the AL test library Library - Permissions does, on request), so the runner now leaves the tenant at its Production default and these tests pin that, plus the two toolkit setters that move it.
